description.value: The Revel bestows a violent bloodlust onto The Ravenous Host. Until the end of its next attacks against creatures which have less than half their maximum hit points have advantage.

The Revel spurs its host into rapid but deleterious action. Until the end of its next turn the Ravenous Host gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class, has advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, and can make one additional attack as part of its multiattack action.

At the end of the Ravenous Host's turn, it suffers 3d6 Psychic damage.

The Revel can take 3 legendary actions. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Revel regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

Available Legendary Actions:

  • Blood Frenzy.

  • Debauched Puppeteer.

  • Ravenous Speed.

The Revel can take 3 legendary actions.
The Revel infuses its Ravenous Host with dark energy. The host regains 13 (3d8) hit points.
The Revel can't wear or carry anything. It can move through solid matter as rough terrain, and cannot be touched or attacked by physical or magical means.

On initiative count 20 (losing all initiative ties), the Revel it can use one of its lair action options. It can't do so while incapacitated or otherwise unable to take actions. If surprised, it can't use one until after its first turn in the combat.

Available Lair Actions:

  • Dark Rejuvenation

The Revel has access to a powerful rejuvenating force it can level on its Ravenous Host.

The Revel selects a hostile creature it can see. This creature must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On success the creature is stunned until the end of their next turn. On failure the creature is Enthralled and overcome with an urge to eat.

On their turn they must spend their movement and action to reach and begin consuming the nearest pile of food in the dining hall. If they are not prevented from consuming food they suffer 1d12 Poison damage. The enthrallment ends at the end of their turn.

The Revel attempts to psychically overwhelm a victim, driving them to hungering madness.
The Revel may force a creature which it has Enthralled to immediately make a weapon or spell attack against an adjacent foe.

Horrible whispers of madness infiltrate your mind while standing near The Revel.

Any creature (other than the Host) which begins its turn within 20 feet of The Revel must make a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 2d8 Psychic damage.

[[lookup @name]] is especially good at warping the minds of the &reference[fey]. When a creature of that type is targeted by on of [[lookup @name]]'s abilities which requires a saving throw, the Fey makes that save with disadvantage.
